title: Lean evidence sequencing

selection.label: Lean evidence is a parallel non-blocking lane after semantic snapshot acceptance
selection.selected_by: CyberAlchemy Lab architecture owner via user reply

binding_effects: CML-05 depends on the accepted CML-04 semantic Definition Snapshot.
CML-06 depends on CML-05 and remains an independently accepted bounded-evidence branch.
CML-07 depends directly on the accepted CML-04 semantic Definition Snapshot and does not depend on CML-05 or CML-06.
Phase order is presentation order; explicit depends_on edges are the execution prerequisites.
Lean provider failure or deferral leaves Lean evidence unresolved but does not revoke an accepted semantic snapshot or block the Craft identity branch.
non_effects: This decision does not accept any Definition Snapshot, FormalClaim, Lean source, provider result, platform profile, environment lock, or architecture proposal.
This decision does not authorize CML-01 or any migration, implementation, installation, Git, publication, release, or deployment effect.
This decision does not make Lean a definition, runtime, implementation, release, or production authority.
remaining_blockers: The revised CAL-PROP-0001, CAL-PROP-0002, and CAL-PROP-0003 immutable digests still require one architecture-owner selection before CML-00 can complete.
claim_ceiling: This decision selects only the dependency relationship between the semantic snapshot, bounded Lean evidence, and Craft identity phases. It does not admit artifacts, accept architecture bytes, complete CML-00, or authorize CML-01.
